en.title: Fed Rate Hold Confidence Rises
en.summary: The probability of no Fed interest rate change by September 2026 rose to 72% (+5.5%). This movement was primarily driven by Maybank Group Wealth Management's Eddy Loh suggesting markets are overestimating U.S. rate hike odds.
drivers: Maybank's Eddy Loh stated markets misprice US rate hike odds.
Iran war deal prospects seen to lower oil prices.
Reduced inflation pressure lessens need for Fed tightening.
en.why_matters: This indicates evolving expectations for long-term monetary policy, impacting investment strategies and economic stability. It signals potential confidence in inflation control without further tightening.
en.bull_case: Maybank's view on mispriced rate hikes gains wider acceptance, signaling stable inflation and no need for Fed action.
en.bear_case: Unexpected inflation resurgence or economic shocks force the Fed to adjust rates, diverging from current stability expectations.

zh.title: 美联储利率维持不变信心增强
zh.summary: 到2026年9月美联储利率不变的概率升至72%（+5.5%）。此次变动主要受马来亚银行财富管理首席投资官Eddy Loh指出市场高估美国加息概率的言论驱动。
drivers: 马来亚银行Eddy Loh称市场高估美联储加息几率。
伊朗和平协议前景预计将降低油价。
通胀压力减小，降低美联储紧缩需求。
zh.why_matters: 这表明市场对长期货币政策的预期正在演变，影响投资策略和经济稳定。它预示着在不进一步收紧的情况下，市场对通胀控制的潜在信心。
zh.bull_case: 马来亚银行关于加息被高估的观点被广泛接受，预示通胀稳定，美联储无需采取行动。
zh.bear_case: 意外的通胀反弹或经济冲击迫使美联储调整利率，偏离当前稳定预期。
